system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.13.5 - Elemental Restorations. Diagnosing bodily damage (Elemental Body Lore), repairing sprains, muscles, cartilage, tendons, and fractures (minor/major), nerve and skull repair, preserving a severed limb's bones/muscles/nerves so it can later be rejoined, eye/joint/organ/brain repair, curing paralysis, reattaching a limb (Elemental Joining), and regenerating any lost body part outright. Special notes from the source: these spells only work on a being that has a number of corruption points, in the caster's element, equal to twice the level of the spell being cast; and most of this list is aimed at corrupted creatures or hybrid elemental beings, since ordinary elementals don't have distinctive limbs or organs. Fidelity notes: levels 1, 3, and 16 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); level 2 (Elemental Body Lore) is the only entry with a non-instant Duration/Range ("—"/100') - every other spell on this list is Permanent/touch.
Caster acquires complete understanding of any bodily damage, including the tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.
Allows to caster to repair (not replace) 1 sprain; recovery time: 1 hour.
Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.) Recovery time is one day.
Allows caster to repair (not replace) 1 damaged muscle, recovery time: 1 hour.
Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time is one day.
Allows caster to repair minor damage to 1 nerve; there is no recovery time. Minor damage is any damage that results in penalties up to -20.
Allows caster to repair one damaged tendon; recovery time: 1 hour.
As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can repair compound fractures. Recovery time is one day.
Allows caster to repair one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered area). Recovery time is 1-10 days (depending on the damage.)
As Minor Nerve Repair, except it will heal any nerve damage.

Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.
Caster can repair any eye damage short of total eye loss (e.g., eye's destruction precludes repair); recovery time: 1-10 days.
Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered joint). Recovery time is 1-10 days.
Caster can cure any 1 paralysis problem.
Allows caster to repair any internal or external organ damage (not including the brain or nervous system); requires a 1-10 hour operation and 1-10 day recovery time.

Allows caster to reattach limb. As long as all four Preservation spells have been cast on the limb this spell succeeds. Otherwise this spell fails. If successful, limb is fully functional in 1-10 days.

Allows caster to repair minor brain damage (including recovery from coma); note that experience lost is not restored (% lost permanently dependent on severity of damage); requires a 1 hour operation; recover time: 1-10 days.
Allows caster to regenerate any one part of the target's body. There is no recovery time.
